basic_details.job_title: RITES Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 5 Individual Consultant and Site Engineer Posts
basic_details.short_information: RITES Limited is engaging five Individual Consultants on a temporary, CV-based assignment at a client's site in Ahmedabad, for an initial tenure of 12 months, with payment for services of Rs. 85,000 to Rs. 2,00,000 per month depending on the post. Engineering graduates in the branch named for each post, with 6 to 15 years of total experience and relevant Metro/Railway experience, can apply online in the Career Section of the RITES website (www.rites.com) from 05.11.2026 until 29.11.2026 (till 23:00). The posts are Site Engineer - Rolling Stock Testing & Commissioning, Section Engineer – Signal

age_limit.details: The age limit for all four posts is "Not exceeding 64 years". Age, experience and all other eligibility criteria are reckoned as on the last date of submission of application, 29 November 2026. The notice lists no age relaxation.

how_to_apply: Open the Career Section of the RITES website, http://www.rites.com, and apply online in the registration format (a valid e-mail ID is essential).
Note down the "Registration No." generated on top of the online form and quote it in all further communication with RITES.
Fill the "Identity Proof" details carefully; the same Identity Proof must be produced in original at later stages.
Upload clear scanned copies of all the documents listed below on the RITES website.
Fill the details under "Fill/ Modify Application Form" and submit the application before 29.11.2026 (till 23:00). Applications once submitted cannot be altered.
Print and sign the online application form containing the registration number, and bring it with the documents and a filled Annexure A at document verification/interview.
Candidates can apply for any number of vacancies. Hard copies of documents are not to be sent by post or courier.
Self-attested photocopies with originals, in this order from top to bottom:
High School certificate for proof of Date of Birth
Certificates of Academic & Professional qualifications and statements of marks for all semesters/years (Xth, XIIth, Diploma/ Graduation/ Post-Graduation as applicable)
Experience certificates from previous employers for the claims made in the application, and proof of different periods of experience (if applicable)
Proof of Identity & Address (Passport, Voter ID, Driving License, Aadhaar Card etc) and PAN Card
Any other document in support of candidature

For current employment, the experience certificate/joining letter with last 3 months' salary slips or last financial year/latest Form 16 must be produced. For proof of CTC/salary, a copy of Form No. 16, Earning Card, salary slip, appraisal letter or other suitable document is required. The Annexure-A checklist additionally lists the 12th marksheet, post-graduation and PhD documents if any, last company relieving letter/experience certificate, NOC (for Govt./PSU employees), Aadhaar Card and 02 recent passport size colour photographs, along with blood group, marital status and category.
important_instructions: Consultants on full-time basis may not take up any other assignment during the consultancy. Candidates working in any organisation, including Government Departments/PSU and departmental candidates of RITES, can join only after being properly relieved. Police verification is done as per MHA instructions; a negative report ends the contract immediately. RITES may require a Statement of Good Health from a recognized physician before work starts. Incorrect claims, suppression of facts or insufficient proof lead to rejection or termination, even after engagement. Any corrigendum/addendum will appear only on www.rites.com. Queries go to [email protected] with VC No., Registration/Roll No., full name in block letters and the registered email.

content_sections.heading: About RITES
content_sections.text: RITES Ltd. describes itself in the notice as a multi-disciplinary Engineering and Consultancy organization providing services in all facets of transport infrastructure, building and other related technologies. Its manpower is provided on CV-based assignments, and this engagement is for deployment of personnel at one of its clients' sites. The notice gives the RITES Corporate Office address as Shikhar, Plot No.01, Sector-29, Gurugram-122001.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: RITES Limited has advertised 5 positions across four posts, all located at Ahmedabad. The notice states that the number of vacancies may vary. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the positions.

rows.post_name: Individual Consultant: Site Engineer - Rolling Stock Testing & Commissioning (NK-55-P1)
Individual Consultant: Rolling Stock Expert – Electrical System (NK-51)
Individual Consultant: Section Engineer - Third Rail & Power Supply & Substation (NK-38-P1)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Site Engineer - Rolling Stock Testing & Commissioning: minimum 02 years relevant experience (i.e. rolling stock testing, commissioning, inspection etc.) in Metro/Railways. Section Engineer – Signalling: minimum 04 years relevant experience (i.e. signalling systems supervision installation, testing, commissioning etc.) in Metro/Railways. Rolling Stock Expert – Electrical System: minimum 05 years relevant experience (i.e. electrical systems of rolling stock, including design review, inspection, testing and commissioning etc.) in Metro/Railways. Section Engineer - Third Rail & Power Supply & Substation: minimum 04 years relevant experience (i.e. third rail systems, traction power supply and substation installation, testing and commissioning etc.) in Metro/Railways. The period of training (except on-the-job training), internship, teaching, academic, fellowship or PhD research experience is not counted as experience. Where a specialisation is required in the qualifying degree, the candidate must submit a certificate from the University/Institution clearly specifying it. The date of acquiring the qualification is the earliest of: the last day of the month of the final examination (or the exact examination date where stated), the date of declaration of result, the date of issue of the marksheet or the date of issue of the degree. The age limit for all four posts is "Not exceeding 64 years". Age, experience and all other eligibility criteria are reckoned as on the last date of submission of application, 29 November 2026. The notice lists no age relaxation. As per Rule 177 of GFR 2017, consulting services do not include direct engagement of retired Government servants, but a retired Government servant can be hired as consultant through a competitive process, only for specific tasks and a specific duration, and not against regular vacant posts. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The payment for services is a fixed monthly amount per post (shown in the vacancy table). The notice also states: Tentative project/work duration is 12 months for each post; the initial tenure of engagement is 12 months, extendable based on the performance of the individual and/or requirement of the project. The engagement may be extended by one year at a time, on the same project only, subject to a satisfactory Annual Performance Review based on Key Performance Indicators. No extension is given beyond the age of 65 years. Where the contract is for more than one year, remuneration may be reviewed annually, based on the escalation received in the client's fee for the previous year. Payment is released within one week after completion of the month, based on attendance registered. There are no statutory benefits such as PF/ESI/Gratuity. Income Tax is deducted at source with TDS certificates issued; Goods and Service Tax, as applicable, is admissible to the consultant. Leave is 1.5 days per completed month, with no accumulation beyond a calendar year; absence up to one month may be considered without remuneration. Women consultants may be eligible for maternity leave under the Maternity Benefit (Amendment) Act, 2017. No TA/DA is admissible for joining the assignment or on its completion. The Individual Consultant has the legal status of an Independent Consultant and is not a staff member or official of RITES Limited; the appointment is of a temporary nature. RITES may terminate the contract at any time without notice or reason, but in the normal course gives one month's notice; the consultant must also give one month's notice to resign.

For proof of CTC/salary, a copy of Form No. 16, Earning Card, salary slip, appraisal letter or other suitable document is required. The Annexure-A checklist additionally lists the 12th marksheet, post-graduation and PhD documents if any, last company relieving letter/experience certificate, NOC (for Govt./PSU employees), Aadhaar Card and 02 recent passport size colour photographs, along with blood group, marital status and category.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The mode of selection is interview only, preceded by document scrutiny. Document Scrutiny/verification: all candidates who submit the online application are provisionally allowed to appear; eligibility for the post applied is verified. Candidates must be present in person or online. Personal Interview: only eligible/shortlisted candidates appear. They are evaluated on technical skills, subject knowledge, experience, communication and interpersonal skills. RITES reserves the right to shortlist the number of candidates. Client approval: CVs of candidates found suitable are shared with the client; only those whose CVs are approved receive an Engagement Letter. Actual deployment depends on award of work/project/company requirement. Document scrutiny and interview will be held at RITES Corporate Office, Shikhar, Plot No.01, Sector-29, Gurugram-122001, or through video conferencing/online, with the link sent to the registered email ID/official chat group. Originals with one set of photocopies must be brought for in-person scrutiny. No TA/DA is payable for attending the interview. Results will be uploaded on the RITES website, showing candidates as Suitable or Not found suitable.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Consultants on full-time basis may not take up any other assignment during the consultancy. Candidates working in any organisation, including Government Departments/PSU and departmental candidates of RITES, can join only after being properly relieved. Police verification is done as per MHA instructions; a negative report ends the contract immediately. RITES may require a Statement of Good Health from a recognized physician before work starts. Incorrect claims, suppression of facts or insufficient proof lead to rejection or termination, even after engagement. Any corrigendum/addendum will appear only on www.rites.com . Queries go to [email protected] with VC No., Registration/Roll No., full name in block letters and the registered email.

content_sections.heading: Important Dates
content_sections.text: The dates for document scrutiny and interview are tentative and may change; RITES may issue a date-wise schedule.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in RITES Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 positions: 2 Site Engineer - Rolling Stock Testing & Commissioning and 1 each of Section Engineer – Signalling, Rolling Stock Expert – Electrical System and Section Engineer - Third Rail & Power Supply & Substation.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date of online application is 29 November 2026, till 23:00.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: Each post needs graduation in a specified engineering branch, such as Electrical/ Mechanical Engineering for Site Engineer, with 6 to 15 years of total experience and 2 to 5 years of relevant Metro/Railway experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age must not exceed 64 years for all posts, reckoned as on 29 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The payment for services is Rs. 85,000/- for Site Engineer, Rs. 1,20,000/- for each Section Engineer post and Rs. 2,00,000/- for Rolling Stock Expert, per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: No. The application fee for all categories of posts is NIL.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply online in the Career Section of the RITES website, http://www.rites.com, and upload scanned copies of the required documents.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is by document scrutiny followed by a personal interview, tentatively on 1–2 and 3–4 December 2026; engagement also depends on the client approving the CV.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is temporary, as an Independent Consultant, for an initial 12 months, extendable based on performance and project requirement but not beyond age 65.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice states that candidates can apply for any number of vacancies.
